title: Criteria for Imposition of Administrative Fines
title_original: 효행 장려 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
[APPENDIX] Criteria for Imposition of Administrative Fines (Related to Article 3)
<Inserted on November 28, 2017>

1. General Criteria
(a) The criteria for increased administrative fines based on the number of violations shall apply where an administrative fine has been imposed for the same violation during the preceding three years. The period shall be calculated from the date on which the administrative fine was imposed for the earlier violation to the date on which the same violation was detected again after that disposition.
(b) When imposing an increased fine pursuant to subparagraph (a), the applicable violation level shall be the level immediately following that of the fine imposed before the current violation. If two or more fines were imposed within the period under subparagraph (a), the highest previous level shall be used.
(c) The imposing authority may reduce the amount under paragraph 2 by up to one half where any of the following applies. This reduction shall not be available to a violator who is in arrears on an administrative fine:
  1) The violator falls within any of the categories specified in Article 2-2 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Regulation of Violations of Public Order;
  2) The violation is recognized as resulting from minor negligence or error;
  3) The violator is recognized as having made efforts to correct or eliminate the violation of the law;
  4) A reduction is considered necessary in view of the seriousness, motive, consequences, or other circumstances of the violation.
(d) The imposing authority may increase the amount under paragraph 2 by up to one half in view of the seriousness, motive, consequences, or other circumstances of the violation. However, the amount must not exceed the upper limit under Article 15 (1) of the Act.

2. Individual Criteria (Unit: 10,000 Korean won)
(a) Violation: Using the name of the Institute for the Promotion of Hyo Culture in contravention of Article 14 of the Act.
  Legal basis: Article 15 (1) of the Act.
  Administrative fine: First violation 300; second violation 300; third or subsequent violation 300.
(b) Violation: Using a name similar to that of the Institute for the Promotion of Hyo Culture in contravention of Article 14 of the Act.
  Legal basis: Article 15 (1) of the Act.
  Administrative fine: First violation 100; second violation 200; third or subsequent violation 300.
